ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the bottom of the picture is labeled “primary producers (plants)” plant producers; above it there is an upward arrow pointing to “detritivores”; further upward there is an upward arrow pointing to the area labeled “carnivores.” On the left and right of the diagram there are also biological categories such as “predatory invertebrates” and “sucking insects,” and overall arrows are used to indicate the direction of the food chain. Reasoning: The question asks what is at the top of the food chain. In the diagram, the higher upward indicates the higher trophic level, and the corresponding category labeled above is “carnivores.” Therefore, the top of the food chain is carnivores.
